# MoneySpent

> Free personal finance and expense tracker for daily spending, budgets, accounts, and spending insights.

## What is MoneySpent?
MoneySpent is a simple, private personal finance tracker. It helps people log expenses in seconds, organize spending by category and account, stay on budget, and understand where money goes—without spreadsheet friction, ads, or a credit card wall.

## Who it is for
- Students tracking pocket money and campus spending
- Freelancers and self-employed professionals separating work and personal costs
- Couples and families managing household budgets
- Creators, developers, remote workers, teachers, and travelers who need fast daily logging
- Anyone who wants a free expense tracker that stays calm and private

## Key facts
- Free forever for personal use ($0 / ₹0 per month)
- No credit card required to start
- No ads and no selling spending habits
- Manual tracking (no bank login required)
- Works as a web app / PWA on phone and desktop
- Used by 2,000+ people for clearer money tracking

## Core features
- Fast sentence-style expense and income logging
- Multiple accounts (cash, bank, wallet, cards)
- Category management and spending insights
- Budget-friendly daily tracking habits
- Import/export for portable records
- Privacy-focused personal finance workspace

## Why choose MoneySpent
MoneySpent focuses on the habit that improves money decisions: logging spends quickly and reviewing categories often. It is intentionally simple—built for personal clarity rather than complex accounting, bank aggregation, or subscription upsells.
